name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2026-01-09, at wavelengths from 0.91 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
